page.overview:
Who is Chrysalla?

Chrysalla was the near-Human Tieress of the planet Ventooine for a period during the reign of the Galactic Empire. As Tieress, Chrysalla lived a life of luxury as the favored ward of the reigning annual Satab. Despite her high station, Chrysalla languished as a captive, trapped and repulsed by the Satab's cruelty. When the mysterious offworlder Han Solo visited Ventooine and saved her life, Chrysalla fell in love with him, and the two began a brief affair. When the Satab plotted to give the Corellian his Shadeshine stone, which would grant him incredible powers but also doom him to an early death, Chrysalla intervened to stop him. She vanquished the Satab by touching the stone herself and receiving its power. When this was accomplished, she entered a state of suspended animation and never saw Solo again.

A female member of the non-Human species native to Ventooine, Chrysalla grew up a peasant on the planet, living a hand-to-mouth existence little different from the world's other oppressed inhabitants. That changed when she came to the attention of the reigning Satab. The Satabs held absolute power over the lives of everyone on Ventooine, due to the mental and physical powers derived from the stone called the Shadeshine. So when the Satab chose Chrysalla to be his Tieress, a favored ward of the ruler, she had no choice but to join him in the sprawling palace in the city of Goyoikin.

The Satab gave Chrysalla a pampered life in exchange for her companionship. She enjoyed every comfort in the palace, a position of honor at court, and the pomp of a royal entourage whenever she traveled about. These luxuries drew the ire of Ventooine's oppressed common folk, but they also made her captivity somewhat tolerable. So did the knowledge that it was temporary: the Shadeshine that gave power to the Satabs also took a toll on their bodies, resulting in an agonizing death known as "burnout." To avoid this, the Satabs ruled for only a single year, after which they would retreat to suspended animation in the Hall of Satabs. Even as Chrysalla did what she could to tolerate or enjoy her year as Tieress, she longed for freedom and for genuine love.

On one occasion, Chrysalla and her attendants were traveling through the streets of Goyoikin. Human offworlder Han Solo approached the procession, hoping to use it to escape from an crowd of angry Ventooinians chasing him from a nearby bar. Solo was threatening some of the guards with his blaster, trying to conceal himself among Chrysalla's entourage, when a pair of local insurgents dropped a bomb from a nearby rooftop hoping to assassinate the Tieress. Solo spotted the bomb as it fell and, reacting quickly, shot it in midair.
